id: \rCynthia: Thank you taking care of those thieves. Unfortunately, we have a different problem to deal with.
en: \rCynthia: Thank you taking care of those thieves.  Unfortunately, we have a different problem to deal with.
it: \rCamilla: Grazie per aver sistemato quei ladri. Purtroppo abbiamo un altro problema da affrontare.

id: \rWe need to head for the research center. The Orb was moved there to be studied. I think they're trying to take it. Don't worry, I'll help you out.
en: \rWe need to head for the research center. The Orb was moved there to be studied. I think they're trying to take it. Don't worry, I'll help you out.
it: \rDobbiamo andare al centro di ricerca. La Sfera è stata portata lì per essere studiata. Credo che vogliano rubarla. Non preoccuparti, ti darò una mano.

id: \rCynthia: I'll need to take care of the ruins, but you deserve something for helping me out.
en: \rCynthia: I'll need to take care of the ruins, but you deserve something for helping me out.
it: \rCamilla: Devo occuparmi delle rovine, ma ti meriti qualcosa per avermi aiutata.

id: \rOh I know. There's an old woman who lives on Route 210. I'll tell her you're coming. She can teach you a special dragon move.
en: \rOh I know. There's an old woman who lives on Route 210. I'll tell her you're coming. She can teach you a special dragon move.
it: \rOh, lo so io. C'è un'anziana signora che vive sul Percorso 210. Le dirò che stai arrivando. Può insegnarti una speciale mossa di tipo Drago.

id: \rThe ruins are quite damaged from your battle. We need time to repair them.
en: \rThe ruins are quite damaged from your battle. We need time to repair them.
it: \rLe rovine sono piuttosto danneggiate dalla vostra lotta. Ci serve tempo per ripararle.

id: \bYou ever stop to think that you're in the wrong.
en: \bYou ever stop to think that you're in the wrong.
it: \bTi sei mai fermato a pensare che forse sei tu dalla parte del torto?
Sala delle Gare Pokémon di Memoride

id: \rWelcome to Celestic Town! May your stay here be informative.
en: \rWelcome to Celestic Town! May your stay here be informative.
it: \rBenvenuto a Memoride! Spero che il tuo soggiorno qui sia istruttivo.
